triggers: a kernel on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120) risks the '8. Deepening prefetch when shared memory is the residency limiter' trap

payload.goal: Avoid a known trap on NVIDIA Blackwell GeForce/workstation (RTX PRO 5000 / SM120): 8. Deepening prefetch when shared memory is the residency limiter

problem.statement: SM120 NVFP4 Decode GEMM Production Pitfalls -- 8. Deepening prefetch when shared memory is the residency limiter

payload.attempted: Long scoreboard is high, so increase the TMA prefetch depth.
payload.lesson: If the kernel is latency-bound with bandwidth headroom, first shrink the weight tile or shared-memory footprint to raise resident blocks per SM. Treat prefetch depth as secondary and verify it does not lower residency.

established_fact.mechanism: In a cold weight-streaming GEMV, shared memory can be the binding resource. More stages consume shared memory and reduce block residency.

payload.observed: Single-warp latency improves but resident blocks per SM drop, reducing total in-flight DRAM requests and lowering bandwidth.
payload.root_cause: In a cold weight-streaming GEMV, shared memory can be the binding resource. More stages consume shared memory and reduce block residency.
